p1: Ethan found a hidden camera in his Airbnb. Covering it was a mistake.
A lake cabin. Forty dollars a night. Five stars.
Every review said: great host, always watching out for you.
One rule on the fridge. Don't touch the smoke alarm.
That night, he tried the trick. Lights off, torch on, look for glints.
A red glint. Inside the smoke alarm.
He put tape over it. Furious.
Seconds later, the host, Mr Abbott, texted.
Why did you cover the camera?
Not you. I was watching it. Now I can't see where it is.
Ethan lifted his torch. Under the bed... two glints.
These days, he checks every room for glints. Last night, at home... he found two.
